description: Buy a fixed dollar amount of one token on a schedule.

TOKEN.description: an address, or a symbol the rail can resolve

CHAIN_ID.description: the chain to buy on; omit to let the rail choose

SIZING.description: dollar-cost averaging is fixed-size by definition

MAX_PER_DAY.description: at most this many buys a day, whatever the schedule says

MAX_USD_PER_DAY.description: at most this many dollars of buys a UTC day; set only when the owner named one
